messages:
evan.sales: Heads up — Acme's security/legal returned the questionnaire. Need final SSO/SCIM answers + POC plan by EOD tomorrow. cc @maya.solutions @riley.eng @anita.sec
maya.solutions: Got it. Which environment do they prefer for the POC — hosted quick-run or Dedicated reserved pool?
riley.eng: They want to start hosted to iterate, but will want Dedicated perf numbers later. Hosted POC fine. SCIM delta ~10k users looks fine; need domain verification + attribute mapping for RBAC.
anita.sec: Key security items in the questionnaire: SAML metadata and cert rotation policy, SCIM rate limits and audit logs retention, KMS/HSM usage, data residency. I'll draft answers unless there are special legal asks.
evan.sales: Pricing question: they want a ballpark for a Dedicated commit for 50k MAU (est ~150M tokens/mo) and SCIM provisioning throughput. Can we give a starter quote + ops support add-on?
maya.solutions: Use the "Dedicated Starter" band for ballpark. I'll DM the exact number to you instead of posting here.
riley.eng: Sample SAML role mapping snippet:
```xml
<saml:Attribute Name="roles" NameFormat="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:attrname-format:unspecified">
  <saml:AttributeValue>app_admin</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
```
They have two domains (acme.com, acme-eu.com) — need DNS TXT for domain proofing and to decide tenant segmentation strategy.
anita.sec: Draft security answers: SOC2 report attached; encryption at rest w/ customer-managed KMS available; SCIM logs retained 90 days by default, extension possible. SCIM default rate-limit: 10 req/s with 300 req/min burst; recommend exponential backoff for bulk operations. We can enable a one-time bulk import endpoint for up to 1M records with scheduling.
evan.sales: They asked about SSO fallback if IdP is down — what's our stance?
riley.eng: We support cached session tokens (session TTL up to 24h) and emergency admin bypass (audited). Also can configure short-lived JWTs for service accounts.
maya.solutions: Proposed POC schedule:
- Day 0: Kickoff + exchange SAML metadata
- Day 1: SCIM sync + initial RBAC mapping
- Day 2: Smoke tests + SSO failover test
- Day 3: Performance run (50k users emulation)
Need Acme's Okta admin + 1 platform engineer. Proposed next Wed 09:00 PT. @acme-admin please confirm.
acme-admin: Confirmed Wed 09:00 PT. We'll share SAML metadata and Okta scaffold by EOD today.
evan.sales: I'll assemble the email with SAML/SCIM checklist + attach SOC2 and network FAQ. @anita.sec please review before I send 🙏
anita.sec: On it — will add cert rotation cadence and contact for KMS onboarding. 👍
ci-bot: deploy scheduled for 1987655000 — smoke tests will run in sandboxes.
evan.sales: Thanks all. I'll post the kickoff invite + send the email. :calendar:
